name.title: Name
name.description: Native job name used to identify this monitor and its history. Renaming creates a separate monitor.

script.title: Script
script.description: Inline Playwright Test JavaScript or TypeScript source. Leave empty when using Script path.

script_path.title: Script path
script_path.description: Absolute path to a readable Playwright Test JavaScript or TypeScript entry file. Leave empty when using Script.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Credentials passed to the workflow as named environment variables. Leave empty for workflows without credentials.

name.title: Environment name
name.description: Unique environment variable name starting with DEM_SECRET_, followed by letters, digits or underscores.

value.title: Value
value.description: Credential value or a native secret reference, such as ${env:WORKFLOW_PASSWORD}.

screenshot_on_failure.title: Capture failure screenshot
screenshot_on_failure.description: Save a screenshot when a workflow check fails. Screenshots can contain sensitive page content; timeout capture is best effort.

trace_on_failure.title: Capture failure trace
trace_on_failure.description: Save a Playwright trace ZIP when a workflow check fails; requires failure screenshots and is disabled by default. ZIPs can contain raw passwords, cookies and request/response bodies without redaction.

browser_error_summary.title: Collect browser error summary
browser_error_summary.description: Collect bounded browser error counts and primitive samples from journey fixture contexts, including passing tests. Disabled by default; enabling can add substantial CPU and memory cost on console-heavy pages and retain sensitive text.

update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Chart refresh interval, in seconds; publishes the latest completed observation without starting a browser check. When upgrading an existing job, move its old browser interval to `check_every`.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Browser attempt budget, in seconds, excluding time waiting for a browser slot. Journeys reserve up to 5 seconds (20% for budgets below 25 seconds) inside this budget for timeout reporting. Verified cleanup and persistence follow execution.

check_every.title: Check every
check_every.description: Browser check interval, in seconds. Checks start independently from chart refreshes; overloaded jobs keep only the newest pending check.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define a static Virtual Node through `dem:vnode` or a YAML file in `vnodes/` under the Netdata configuration directory, then enter its reference name here. Leave empty to use the collecting Agent.

trace_on_failure.ui:help:
Recording adds CPU, memory and temporary disk use even on passing runs. ZIPs above 5 MiB are omitted; timeout capture is best effort. Download retained ZIPs and open them with the Playwright Trace Viewer.

After downgrading to an Agent without trace support, capture sets containing traces cannot be read, including their screenshots, and are excluded from retention cleanup until re-upgrade.
